description: NaSrNbSnO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.87 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.87 Å. Nb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SnO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Nb-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. Sn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sn-O bond lengths are 2.06 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, one Nb, and one Sn atom.
